svg.title: Benly logo construction — assembling memory
svg.desc: The exact Benly logo is deconstructed into memory and language fragments, then assembled into a completed dream.

g.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', sans-serif
g.text: 기억과 언어의 조각을 모아, 일상 속에서 꿈을 완성하다.
Fragments of memory and language become the shape of an everyday dream.
